limitations: word/token counts alone do not capture pronunciation, silence or machine scheduling
notes: Actual native text input IDs, returned PCM and delivery clocks are retained. Delivery recording does not capture deep acoustic/model features; their availability is explicit in each reply recording scope. Warmup/capture records are retained separately. Training body token IDs are supervised targets, not sampled Thinker IDs.
